title.zh: 将利帕市萨邦村萨邦小学的名称变更为G.B. Lontok纪念小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Sabang Elementary School in the Barrio of Sabang, City of Lipa, to G.B. Lontok Memorial Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Sabang Elementary School in the Barrio of Sabang, City of Lipa, to G.B. Lontok Memorial Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Sabang tại Barrio Sabang, Thành phố Lipa thành Trường tiểu học G.B. Lontok Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Sabang ในบารริโอ Sabang, เมือง Lipa เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา G.B. Lontok Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Sabang di Barrio Sabang, Kota Lipa menjadi Sekolah Dasar G.B. Lontok Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Sabang di Barrio Sabang, Bandaraya Lipa menjadi Sekolah Rendah G.B. Lontok Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1423_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Sabang Elementary School in the barrio of Sabang, City of Lipa, is changed to G.B. Lontok Memorial Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1956.
